high_level_description: The image features a person standing outdoors in a sunny environment. The individual is wearing a white tank top, which reveals tattoos on both arms. Around their neck, they have a thick gold chain necklace. The person is also wearing a white baseball cap with "OAKLAND" written across the front in green letters. They are sporting large aviator-style sunglasses with orange-tinted lenses, which give them a stylish and confident appearance.
